document_title: Dallas AI cameras on brush trucks flag concerns, not violations
_note: Slide strings read off the render report's text nodes and each frame's own source line by build_copy.py.
caption:
3,700 courtesy notices. 57 citations. Not the same thing.

Cameras on Dallas sanitation trucks scanned 10,000 properties, the city's September 8th memo says, as FOX 4 reported. The memo says code officers reviewed and confirmed the detections behind the 57 citations, and that a citation comes only after an officer inspects the property and notifies the owner, Dallas Express and FOX 4 reported.

39 of the 57 citations were in Council Districts 4, 8 and 7 in southern Dallas, by the city manager's memo. Council member Chad West withdrew a move to cut the funding once the city manager's office agreed to brief the council.

The city's December 2025 briefing describes a three-year contract at $852,000 a year, subject to annual City Council appropriations. What should the council see before it funds another year?

#DallasCityCouncil #SouthernDallas #CodeCompliance

S1.headline: The brush truck carries a camera
S1.body: Dallas put AI cameras from City Detect on its sanitation brush and bulk trash trucks. They face sideways and capture images from the public right of way. The camera and truck are drawn to illustrate.
strings: The brush truck carries a camera
Dallas put AI cameras from City Detect on its sanitation brush and bulk trash trucks. They face sideways and capture images from the public right of way. The camera and truck are drawn to illustrate.

S2.headline: It flags a concern, not a violation
S2.body: Software marks possible conditions from the city's list. A blight score helps staff decide which properties to review first. Faces and license plates are blurred.
strings: It flags a concern, not a violation
Software marks possible conditions from the city's list. A blight score helps staff decide which properties to review first. Faces and license plates are blurred.

S3.headline: A person reviews the flag
S3.body: Human review is required before enforcement, the city maintains. Its own briefing says a human stays in the loop.
strings: Human review is required before enforcement, the city maintains. Its own briefing says a human stays in the loop.

S4.headline: Some get a courtesy notice
S4.body: About 3,700 property owners got one after the cameras flagged a possible violation, the city says.
strings: About 3,700 property owners got one after the cameras flagged a possible violation, the city says.

S5.headline: An officer inspects in person
S5.body: The memo says a citation comes only after a code officer inspects the property and notifies the owner, and counts 57 citations at 34 properties.
strings: The memo says a citation comes only after a code officer inspects the property and notifies the owner, and counts 57 citations at 34 properties.

S6.headline: 10,000 properties scanned
S6.body: One card here for each property, the memo's count as FOX 4 reported it. The 57 citations are the sheaf in his hand.
strings: One card here for each property, the memo's count as FOX 4 reported it. The 57 citations are the sheaf in his hand.

S7.headline: Most citations were in southern Dallas
S7.body: 39 of the 57 were in Council Districts 4, 8 and 7, the city manager's memo says. One card here for each citation.
strings: Most citations were in southern Dallas
39 of the 57 were in Council Districts 4, 8 and 7, the city manager's memo says. One card here for each citation.

S8.headline: The council funds it a year at a time
S8.body: The city's December briefing set the terms. A three-year contract subject to annual City Council appropriations, $852,000 a year, and an exit on 10 days' written notice. Chad West withdrew a move to cut the funding once the city manager's office agreed to brief the council.
strings: The council funds it a year at a time

S9.headline: A notice asks for no action yet
S9.body: City officials say a courtesy notice is not a citation and requires no action. The notice warns that continued violations could bring a citation or other enforcement.
